headline: Candidate endorsements from the Weekly’s editorial board are not a way to make friends.
summary: Sara Rubin here, wondering what tools you use to decide how to vote. Maybe you’ve followed a candidate’s political career to date and paid attention to their stance on the issues that matter to you.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
